import java.util.concurrent.*; class Sleeper { volatile boolean asleep; void tryToSleep() { while (!asleep) countSomeSheep(); } void countSomeSheep() { try { Thread.sleep(1); } catch (InterruptedException e) { Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); } } } public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { Sleeper sleeper = new Sleeper(); ExecutorService es = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2); es.execute(() -> { sleeper.tryToSleep(); }); es.execute(() -> { try { Thread.sleep(10); } catch (InterruptedException e) { Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); } sleeper.asleep = true; }); es.shutdown(); es.awaitTermination(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS); } }

import java.math.BigInteger; import java.util.*; import java.util.concurrent.*; class OneValueCache { private final BigInteger lastNumber; private final BigInteger[] lastFactors; OneValueCache(BigInteger number, BigInteger[] factors) { lastNumber = number; lastFactors = Arrays.copyOf(factors, factors.length); } BigInteger[] getFactors(BigInteger number) { if (!lastNumber.equals(number)) return null; return Arrays.copyOf(lastFactors, lastFactors.length); } } class Factorizer { private volatile OneValueCache cache = new OneValueCache(BigInteger.ONE, new BigInteger[] { BigInteger.ONE }); BigInteger[] service(BigInteger input) { BigInteger[] factors = cache.getFactors(input); if (factors == null) { factors = new BigInteger[] { input }; cache = new OneValueCache(input, factors); } return factors; } } public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { Factorizer factorizer = new Factorizer(); ExecutorService es = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2); es.execute(() -> { factorizer.service(BigInteger.ONE); }); es.execute(() -> { factorizer.service(BigInteger.valueOf(2)); }); es.shutdown(); es.awaitTermination(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS); } }

import java.util.*; import java.util.concurrent.*; class Point { public final int x; public final int y; Point(int x, int y) { this.x = x; this.y = y; } } class DelegatingVehicleTracker { private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, Point> locations; DelegatingVehicleTracker(Map<String, Point> initial) { locations = new ConcurrentHashMap<>(initial); } Map<String, Point> getLocations() { return Collections.unmodifiableMap(locations); } Point getLocation(String id) { return locations.get(id); } void setLocation(String id, int x, int y) { if (locations.replace(id, new Point(x, y)) == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException(); } Map<String, Point> getLocationsAsStatic() { return Collections.unmodifiableMap(new HashMap<>(locations)); } } public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { Map<String, Point> initial = new HashMap<>(); initial.put(String.valueOf(1), new Point(0, 0)); DelegatingVehicleTracker tracker = new DelegatingVehicleTracker(initial); ExecutorService es = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(5); es.execute(() -> { tracker.setLocation(String.valueOf(1), 1, 1); }); es.execute(() -> { tracker.getLocation(String.valueOf(1)); }); es.execute(() -> { tracker.getLocations(); }); es.execute(() -> { tracker.getLocationsAsStatic(); }); es.execute(() -> { tracker.getLocation(String.valueOf(2)); }); es.shutdown(); es.awaitTermination(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS); } }

import java.util.*; import java.util.concurrent.*; class SafePoint { public volatile int x; public volatile int y; SafePoint(int x, int y) { this.x = x; this.y = y; } } class PublishingVehicleTracker { private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, SafePoint> locations; PublishingVehicleTracker(Map<String, SafePoint> initial) { locations = new ConcurrentHashMap<>(initial); } Map<String, SafePoint> getLocations() { return Collections.unmodifiableMap(locations); } SafePoint getLocation(String id) { SafePoint p = locations.get(id); return p == null ? null : new SafePoint(p.x, p.y); } void setLocation(String id, int x, int y) { SafePoint p = locations.get(id); if (p == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException(); p.x = x; p.y = y; } } public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { Map<String, SafePoint> initial = new HashMap<>(); initial.put(String.valueOf(1), new SafePoint(0, 0)); PublishingVehicleTracker tracker = new PublishingVehicleTracker(initial); ExecutorService es = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2); es.execute(() -> { tracker.setLocation(String.valueOf(1), 2, 2); }); es.execute(() -> { tracker.getLocation(String.valueOf(1)); }); es.shutdown(); es.awaitTermination(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS); } }

import java.util.*; import java.util.concurrent.*; class ImproveList<T> extends AbstractList<T> implements List<T> { private final List<T> list; ImproveList(List<T> backing) { list = backing; } public int size() { return list.size(); } public T get(int index) { return list.get(index); } public synchronized T set(int index, T element) { return list.set(index, element); } public synchronized void add(int index, T element) { list.add(index, element); } public synchronized boolean add(T element) { return list.add(element); } public synchronized T remove(int index) { return list.remove(index); } public synchronized boolean remove(Object o) { return list.remove(o); } public synchronized boolean addAll(Collection<? extends T> c) { return list.addAll(c); } public synchronized boolean addAll(int index, Collection<? extends T> c) { return list.addAll(index, c); } public synchronized void clear() { list.clear(); } public synchronized boolean putIfAbsent(T element) { boolean present = list.contains(element); if (!present) list.add(element); return !present; } } public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { ImproveList<Integer> list = new ImproveList<>(new ArrayList<>()); ExecutorService es = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2); es.execute(() -> { list.add(1); }); es.execute(() -> { list.putIfAbsent(1); }); es.shutdown(); es.awaitTermination(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS); } }

import java.math.BigInteger; import java.util.*; import java.util.concurrent.*; class PrimeGenerator implements Runnable { private volatile boolean cancelled; private final List<BigInteger> primes = Collections.synchronizedList(new ArrayList<>()); public void run() { BigInteger current = BigInteger.ONE; long end = System.currentTimeMillis() + 1000; while (!cancelled && System.currentTimeMillis() < end) { current = current.nextProbablePrime(); primes.add(current); } } void cancel() { cancelled = true; } List<BigInteger> getPrimes() { return primes; } } public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { ExecutorService es = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(1); PrimeGenerator generator = new PrimeGenerator(); Future<?> future = es.submit(generator); Thread.sleep(1000); generator.cancel(); future.get(); es.shutdown(); generator.getPrimes(); } }

import java.math.BigInteger; import java.util.*; import java.util.concurrent.*; class PrimeGenerator implements Runnable { private volatile boolean cancelled; private final List<BigInteger> primes = Collections.synchronizedList(new ArrayList<>()); private final ExecutorService executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(1); public void run() { BigInteger current = BigInteger.ONE; long end = System.currentTimeMillis() + 1000; while (!cancelled && primes.size() < 10 && System.currentTimeMillis() < end) { current = current.nextProbablePrime(); primes.add(current); } } void start() { executor.submit(this); } void cancel() { cancelled = true; executor.shutdown(); } List<BigInteger> getPrimes() { return primes; } } public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { PrimeGenerator generator = new PrimeGenerator(); generator.start(); Thread.sleep(1000); generator.cancel(); generator.getPrimes(); } }

import java.util.concurrent.*; class StripedMap { static final int N_LOCKS = 16; private final Node[] buckets; private final Object[] locks; static class Node { Object key; Object value; Node next; Node(Object key, Object value, Node next) { this.key = key; this.value = value; this.next = next; } } StripedMap(int bucketCount) { buckets = new Node[bucketCount]; locks = new Object[N_LOCKS]; for (int i = 0; i < N_LOCKS; i++) locks[i] = new Object(); } int hashIndex(Object key) { return (key.hashCode() & 0x7fffffff) % buckets.length; } Object get(Object key) { int index = hashIndex(key); synchronized (locks[index % N_LOCKS]) { Node node = buckets[index]; while (node != null) { if (node.key.equals(key)) return node.value; node = node.next; } return null; } } void put(Object key, Object value) { int index = hashIndex(key); synchronized (locks[index % N_LOCKS]) { buckets[index] = new Node(key, value, buckets[index]); } } void clear() { for (int i = 0; i < buckets.length; i++) { synchronized (locks[i % N_LOCKS]) { buckets[i] = null; } } } } public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { StripedMap map = new StripedMap(4); ExecutorService es = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(4); es.execute(() -> { map.put(1, 2); }); es.execute(() -> { map.get(1); }); es.execute(() -> { map.put(3, 4); }); es.execute(() -> { map.clear(); }); es.shutdown(); es.awaitTermination(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS); } }

import java.util.concurrent.*; class BoundedBuffer<E> { private final Object[] items; private int putPtr; private int takePtr; private int count; private final Semaphore availableItems; private final Semaphore availableSpaces; BoundedBuffer(int capacity) { items = new Object[capacity]; availableItems = new Semaphore(0); availableSpaces = new Semaphore(capacity); } boolean isEmpty() { synchronized (this) { return count == 0; } } boolean isFull() { synchronized (this) { return count == items.length; } } void put(E item) throws InterruptedException { availableSpaces.acquire(); synchronized (this) { items[putPtr] = item; if (++putPtr == items.length) putPtr = 0; count++; } availableItems.release(); } E take() throws InterruptedException { availableItems.acquire(); E item; synchronized (this) { item = (E) items[takePtr]; items[takePtr] = null; if (++takePtr == items.length) takePtr = 0; count--; } availableSpaces.release(); return item; } } public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { BoundedBuffer<Integer> buffer = new BoundedBuffer<>(1); ExecutorService es = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2); es.execute(() -> { try { buffer.put(1); } catch (InterruptedException e) { Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); } }); es.execute(() -> { try { buffer.take(); } catch (InterruptedException e) { Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); } }); es.shutdown(); es.awaitTermination(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS); } }

import java.util.*; import java.util.concurrent.*; import java.util.concurrent.locks.*; class ReadWriteMap<K, V> { private final Map<K, V> map; private final ReentrantReadWriteLock lock = new ReentrantReadWriteLock(); ReadWriteMap(Map<K, V> map) { this.map = map; } public V put(K key, V value) { lock.writeLock().lock(); try { return map.put(key, value); } finally { lock.writeLock().unlock(); } } public V remove(Object key) { lock.writeLock().lock(); try { return map.remove(key); } finally { lock.writeLock().unlock(); } } public void putAll(Map<? extends K, ? extends V> m) { lock.writeLock().lock(); try { map.putAll(m); } finally { lock.writeLock().unlock(); } } public void clear() { lock.writeLock().lock(); try { map.clear(); } finally { lock.writeLock().unlock(); } } public V get(Object key) { lock.readLock().lock(); try { return map.get(key); } finally { lock.readLock().unlock(); } } public int size() { lock.readLock().lock(); try { return map.size(); } finally { lock.readLock().unlock(); } } public boolean isEmpty() { lock.readLock().lock(); try { return map.isEmpty(); } finally { lock.readLock().unlock(); } } public boolean containsKey(Object key) { lock.readLock().lock(); try { return map.containsKey(key); } finally { lock.readLock().unlock(); } } public boolean containsValue(Object value) { lock.readLock().lock(); try { return map.containsValue(value); } finally { lock.readLock().unlock(); } } } public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { ReadWriteMap<Integer, Integer> map = new ReadWriteMap<>(new HashMap<>()); ExecutorService es = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(3); es.execute(() -> { map.put(1, 1); }); es.execute(() -> { map.get(1); }); es.execute(() -> { map.size(); }); es.shutdown(); es.awaitTermination(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS); } }

import java.util.concurrent.*; class SimulatedCAS { private int value; public synchronized int get() { return value; } public synchronized int compareAndSwap(int expectedValue, int newValue) { int oldValue = value; if (oldValue == expectedValue) value = newValue; return oldValue; } public synchronized boolean compareAndSet(int expectedValue, int newValue) { return compareAndSwap(expectedValue, newValue) == expectedValue; } } public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { SimulatedCAS cas = new SimulatedCAS(); ExecutorService es = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(1); es.execute(() -> { cas.compareAndSet(0, 1); }); es.shutdown(); es.awaitTermination(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS); } }

import java.util.concurrent.*; import java.util.concurrent.atomic.*; class ConcurrentStack<E> { static class Node<E> { E item; Node<E> next; Node(E item) { this.item = item; } } private final AtomicReference<Node<E>> top = new AtomicReference<>(); void push(E item) { Node<E> newHead = new Node<>(item); Node<E> oldHead; do { oldHead = top.get(); newHead.next = oldHead; } while (!top.compareAndSet(oldHead, newHead)); } E pop() { Node<E> oldHead; Node<E> newHead; do { oldHead = top.get(); if (oldHead == null) return null; newHead = oldHead.next; } while (!top.compareAndSet(oldHead, newHead)); return oldHead.item; } } public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { ConcurrentStack<Integer> stack = new ConcurrentStack<>(); ExecutorService es = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(3); for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) { es.execute(() -> { for (int j = 0; j < 5; j++) { stack.push(j); System.out.print('P'); } for (int j = 0; j < 5; j++) { stack.pop(); System.out.print('O'); } }); } es.shutdown(); es.awaitTermination(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS); System.out.print('C'); } }

import java.util.concurrent.*; class Counter { private long value; public synchronized long getValue() { return value; } public synchronized long increment() { if (value == Long.MAX_VALUE) throw new IllegalStateException(new String(new char[] { 'c', 'o', 'u', 'n', 't', 'e', 'r', ' ', 'o', 'v', 'e', 'r', 'f', 'l', 'o', 'w' })); return ++value; } } public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { Counter counter = new Counter(); ExecutorService es = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2); es.execute(() -> { counter.increment(); }); es.execute(() -> { counter.getValue(); }); es.shutdown(); es.awaitTermination(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS); } }

import java.util.*; import java.util.concurrent.*; class BoundedHashSet<T> { private final Set<T> set = Collections.synchronizedSet(new HashSet<T>()); private final Semaphore semaphore; BoundedHashSet(int bound) { semaphore = new Semaphore(bound); } public boolean add(T element) { try { semaphore.acquire(); } catch (InterruptedException e) { Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); return false; } boolean added; try { added = set.add(element); } finally { if (!added) semaphore.release(); } return added; } public boolean remove(Object element) { boolean removed = set.remove(element); if (removed) semaphore.release(); return removed; } } public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { BoundedHashSet<Integer> set = new BoundedHashSet<>(2); ExecutorService es = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(4); es.execute(() -> { set.add(1); }); es.execute(() -> { set.add(2); }); es.execute(() -> { set.remove(1); }); es.execute(() -> { set.add(3); }); es.shutdown(); es.awaitTermination(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS); } }

import java.util.*; import java.util.concurrent.*; import java.util.regex.Pattern; public class BetterAttributeStore { private final Map<String, String> attributes = new HashMap<>(); public synchronized void put(String key, String value) { attributes.put(key, value); } public boolean userLocationMatches(String name, String regexp) { String key = name + new String(new char[] { '.', 'l', 'o', 'c', 'a', 't', 'i', 'o', 'n' }); String location; synchronized (this) { location = attributes.get(key); } if (location == null) return false; return Pattern.matches(regexp, location); } public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { BetterAttributeStore store = new BetterAttributeStore(); String name = new String(new char[] { 'u', '1' }); store.put(name + new String(new char[] { '.', 'l', 'o', 'c', 'a', 't', 'i', 'o', 'n' }), new String(new char[] { 'n', 'y' })); ExecutorService es = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(4); for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) { es.execute(() -> { store.userLocationMatches(name, new String(new char[] { '.', '' })); }); } es.shutdown(); es.awaitTermination(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS); } }

import java.util.*; import java.util.concurrent.*; public class ServerStatusBeforeSplit { private final Set<String> users = new HashSet<>(); private final Set<String> queries = new HashSet<>(); public synchronized void addUser(String u) { users.add(u); } public synchronized void addQuery(String q) { queries.add(q); } public synchronized void removeUser(String u) { users.remove(u); } public synchronized void removeQuery(String q) { queries.remove(q); } public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { ServerStatusBeforeSplit status = new ServerStatusBeforeSplit(); ExecutorService es = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2); es.execute(() -> { status.addUser(String.valueOf(1)); }); es.execute(() -> { status.addQuery(String.valueOf(2)); }); es.shutdown(); es.awaitTermination(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS); } }

import java.util.concurrent.*; public class BarrierTimer implements Runnable { private boolean started; private long startTime; private long endTime; public synchronized void run() { long now = System.nanoTime(); if (!started) { started = true; startTime = now; } else { endTime = now; } } public synchronized void clear() { started = false; } public synchronized long getTime() { return endTime - startTime; } public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { BarrierTimer timer = new BarrierTimer(); ExecutorService es = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2); es.execute(() -> { timer.run(); }); es.execute(() -> { timer.run(); }); es.shutdown(); es.awaitTermination(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS); timer.getTime(); timer.clear(); } }

import java.util.concurrent.*; public class CasCounter { private final SimulatedCAS cas = new SimulatedCAS(); public int getValue() { return cas.get(); } public int increment() { int oldValue; do { oldValue = cas.get(); } while (cas.compareAndSwap(oldValue, oldValue + 1) != oldValue); return oldValue + 1; } static class SimulatedCAS { private int value; public synchronized int get() { return value; } public synchronized int compareAndSwap(int expectedValue, int newValue) { int oldValue = value; if (oldValue == expectedValue) value = newValue; return oldValue; } } public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception { CasCounter counter = new CasCounter(); ExecutorService es = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2); es.execute(() -> { counter.increment(); }); es.execute(() -> { counter.increment(); }); es.shutdown(); es.awaitTermination(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS); } }
